title: QUIZ - 94
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.concept: Interpreting the Intersection of Two Graphs
questions.learningObjective: Interpret the meaning of the intersection point of two graphed linear relationships
questions.question: Two lines are graphed: y = 3x + 7 and y = 1x + 7. What does their intersection point represent?

options.label: A
options.text: A point that has no mathematical meaning.

options.label: B
options.text: The maximum value reached by either line.

options.label: C
options.text: The point where both lines cross the y-axis.

options.label: D
options.text: The input value where both relationships produce the same output.

questions.explanation: At the intersection, both equations are satisfied simultaneously, meaning both relationships give the same output for the same input (at x = 0).
questions.hint: Think about what must be true about both equations at any point where their graphs cross.

questions.concept: Comparing Steepness Between Two Graphed Lines
questions.learningObjective: Compare the steepness of two lines shown on the same graph using their slopes
questions.question: Line B has a slope of 5, and Line A has a slope of 8, both on the same graph. Which line rises more steeply?

options.label: A
options.text: Both lines rise equally steeply.

options.label: B
options.text: Line A

options.label: C
options.text: Steepness cannot be compared from slopes alone.

options.label: D
options.text: Line B

questions.explanation: A greater slope value corresponds to a steeper line. Since 8 > 5, Line A is steeper.
questions.hint: The line with the larger slope value is the steeper line.

questions.concept: Comparing Growth Rates Between Two Graphs
questions.learningObjective: Compare the growth rates of two entities using the slopes of their graphed lines
questions.question: On a graph, Investment A's revenue grows with a slope of 12, and Company B's revenue grows with a slope of 7. Which is growing faster over time?

options.label: A
options.text: Both grow at the same rate.

options.label: B
options.text: This cannot be determined from slopes.

options.label: C
options.text: Investment A

options.label: D
options.text: Company B

questions.explanation: The slope represents the rate of growth. Since 12 > 7, Investment A is growing faster.
questions.hint: A larger slope on a graph of value versus time indicates a faster rate of growth.
